items.title: SiteVerdict — UK Gender Pay Gap Data & Benchmarks

sector-benchmark.eventDescription: One sector benchmark (per-year statistics) is delivered

missing-filing-flag.eventDescription: One possibly-missing filing row is delivered

filing-change-alert.eventDescription: Monitor mode finds a new or amended filing for a watched employer

ai-brief.eventDescription: The user's own AI key returned a brief (never charged on failure)

contact-email.eventDescription: One contact email discovered for a row and attached to it. Charged only when an address is actually found — lookups that find nothing are free. Requires the enrichEmails option.

items.title: Welcome to the Jungle Scraper: WTJ Tech Jobs FR/EU + Salaries
items.name: welcome-to-the-jungle-scraper
items.description: Scrape Welcome to the Jungle jobs by keyword, country, contract, city, remote. Get salary, native tech stack, benefits, apply URL + ATS vendor, company profile, and — uniquely — the employer's application-form screening questions. Optional AI fit-scoring + SIREN. $0.50/1K jobs.

job-scraped.eventDescription: One WTJ job with full details: title, company, salary, native tech stack (skills/tools), benefits, apply URL + detected ATS vendor, and the full company profile (equality index, ESG labels, sectors, website).

company-enriched.eventDescription: Optional per-job company intelligence when enrichCompany=true: employer resolved to its French SIREN with legal name, size (headcount range), sector (NAF), category (PME/ETI/GE), age and administrative status (active vs. ceased). Free official register — data no WTJ-only scraper can produce. Charged ON TOP of job-scraped only for employers successfully resolved.

job-analyzed.eventDescription: Optional AI enrichment per job when analyzeJobs=true: plain-language summary, inferred seniority + remote, truly-required skills, red flags, and (with a candidate profile) a 0-100 fit_score + apply/maybe/skip action. Paid Apify plan only. Charged ON TOP of job-scraped when the user opts into AI analysis.

currentPricingInfo.reasonForChange: Per-job price rises $0.0005 -> $0.0015 ($1.50/1,000), still the cheapest Welcome to the Jungle scraper and under the $5/1,000 job-data norm. Employer SIREN enrichment stays included; AI analysis unchanged (OFF by default).

items.title: Official Company Headcount: US, UK, France, Norway & 6 more
items.name: company-registry-headcount
items.description: Company size and employee count from official registries, by name, number or website: US (Form 5500), UK (Companies House, size bands), France (INSEE), Norway (NAV), Latvia, Estonia, Czechia, Slovakia, Romania, Japan. Or US employers by state, size. Source and date on each row. No figure, $0.

actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run. Put all your companies in one run and you pay this once.

company.eventDescription: One company with its registry number, the official headcount or band, its reference year, source and licence. $2.00 per 1,000. Error and not-found rows are not charged.

items.title: PayScale Company Benefits Scraper
items.name: payscale-company-benefits-scraper
items.description: Scrape employee benefits, perks and pay by company from PayScale across 29 country editions: ranked benefits with sample sizes, 401(k), health, PTO and tuition flags, salary percentiles, ratings and reviews.

currentPricingInfo.reasonForChange: Enterprise discount: PLATINUM and DIAMOND plans now pay less per result than GOLD. All other prices are unchanged.

employer-benefits.eventDescription: One employer: the ranked employee-reported benefits with how many staff reported each, the health and retirement catalogues, 14 yes/no benefit flags, headline salary, total compensation, hourly rate and bonus medians. 40 fields.

directory-page.eventDescription: One industry or industry-plus-letter page of the country directory, which yields up to 100 employers. This is the cost of discovering companies you did not name yourself.

sitemap-scan.eventDescription: One 5.8 MB research sitemap parsed when sitemap discovery is on. Reaches the 8,844 employers with published benefits across 64 country editions, including countries with no directory.

company-profile.eventDescription: Website, domain, founding date, organisation type, employee count range, logo, Wikipedia link, former names and the headquarters address. Charged only when the profile actually came back.

related-employers.eventDescription: The employers PayScale considers comparable by pay, each with its median and percentile spread. Charged only when the list is non-empty.

peer-comparison.eventDescription: Job satisfaction, stress rating and gender split for this employer alongside named competitors. Charged only when PayScale publishes it.

office-locations.eventDescription: Total number of locations with pay data plus the top cities and their report URLs. Charged only when locations came back.

compensation-percentiles.eventDescription: The 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th and 90th percentile for salary, total compensation, hourly rate, bonus, profit sharing and commission, each with its sample size.

employer-ratings.eventDescription: Nine scored dimensions with sample sizes: overall satisfaction, fair pay, pay transparency, pay policy, appreciation, company outlook, learning and development, manager communication and manager relationship. Needs an extra page load.

pay-by-job.eventDescription: Median and percentile pay for each job title reported at the employer, paginated seven per page load. Charged once per employer that returned a job table.

pay-by-location.eventDescription: Median and percentile pay broken down by city and state, with sample sizes.

pay-by-experience.eventDescription: Median and percentile pay by years-of-experience band, with sample sizes.

pay-by-gender.eventDescription: Median and percentile pay for men and women with sample sizes, which is what a gender pay gap calculation needs.

pay-by-degree.eventDescription: Median and percentile pay by degree major, with sample sizes.

hourly-rate-report.eventDescription: The hourly pay report: percentiles, hourly rate by job title and by location, plus the written summary. Needs an extra page load.

bonus-report.eventDescription: The bonus report: percentiles, bonus by job title and the written summary. Needs an extra page load.

employee-reviews.eventDescription: Employee written reviews with job title, city, pros, cons and date, seven per page load. Charged once per employer that returned at least one review.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

items.title: Welcome to the Jungle Gender Equality Index Scores
items.name: wttj-equality-index
items.description: Every French professional equality index published on Welcome to the Jungle, with all five indicators split out. The indicator fields are POINTS SCORED and not the size of a gap, so a pay gap field of 40 is a full mark. No filter exists for the score, so profiles are read to find it.

actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run, and only after published indexes are actually returned. A run that finds no company publishing one costs you nothing.

index-returned.eventDescription: Charged for each published equality index written to your dataset, after it is saved. Company profiles read that publish no index are never charged, and a company indexed on several storefronts is read once and charged once.

items.title: Built In Tech Salaries, by Title, Metro Area and Experience
items.name: builtin-salaries
items.description: US tech salaries from builtin.com for 200 titles, nationally, remote or in any of 50 metro areas: average, median, range, percentiles, the histogram, and breakdowns by experience, gender and company size. Every row carries how many people answered.

actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run, and only after at least one row is returned. A run naming only titles the pages do not know costs you nothing.

row-returned.eventDescription: Charged for each row written to your dataset, after it is saved. A page with no respondents is reported and not charged.

items.title: SEO Audit API - On-Page Score, Issues and Fixes
items.name: seo-audit-api
items.description: Most SEO checkers fetch raw html, so a javascript page scores as an empty shell and you still pay for the row. This one opens every url in its own Chromium: a 0-100 score, each issue with severity and a fix, and a page it could not read comes back free with a reason.

currentPricingInfo.reasonForChange: Initial price: one audited page costs 0.01 USD. A page that could not be read, a duplicate, a cut line and everything after a stop cost nothing and say why.

page-audited.eventDescription: Charged once per page delivered with a 0-100 score, its issues with weights and fixes. A page that could not be read, a duplicate, a cut line and everything after a stop cost nothing.
